study type: Model-based Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
exposure: combination of acetaminophen and topical diclofenac (AtopD)
cohort: The study included a total of 1396 patients from 11 randomized controlled trials focusing on acute pain.
finding: The combination of acetaminophen and topical diclofenac showed greater pain reduction and opioid-sparing efficacy compared to acetaminophen monotherapy.
